description_en: Text Moderation Plus is an upgraded service that moderates the input instructions and generated text of large language models (LLMs). This service can retrieve standard answers for specific input instructions and lets you enable or disable moderation labels
description_zh: 文本审核增强版升级PLUS服务，面向大语言模型的输入指令和生成文字分别提供审核服务，特定的模型输入指令支持检索标准回答，同时开放审核标签的开启和关闭功能
kebab_example: aliyun green text-moderation-plus --service ugc_moderation_byllm --service-parameters content_:_Test_content --api-version 2022-03-02 --region cn-hangzhou
